people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Sharon
people.line: Region where Gadites pastured their flocks

translations.web: They lived in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon, as far as their borders.
translations.bsb: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon.
translations.kjv: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
translations.asv: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, as far as their borders.
